src/domains/ble.ts.name: Bluetooth mock
src/domains/ble.ts.description: A seeded Bluetooth device with a battery service and a serial-style service; answers open, services, read, write, subscribe and close.

src/domains/capture.ts.name: Camera and screen capture mock
src/domains/capture.ts.description: Answers capture info, start, status, stop, cancel and release, with controls to simulate the user stopping, a lost device or expiry.

src/domains/display.ts.name: External display mock
src/domains/display.ts.description: Lists pretend displays and accepts pixel pushes to them.

src/domains/gamepad.ts.name: Game controller mock
src/domains/gamepad.ts.description: Two seeded controllers; napplets subscribe to state, and controls press buttons, move sticks, change focus or unplug a pad.

src/domains/location.ts.name: Location mock
src/domains/location.ts.description: Handles per-window location permission, the current position and subscriptions that push position updates.

src/domains/media.ts.name: Media playback mock
src/domains/media.ts.description: Manages playback sessions over a placeholder playlist, its state, capabilities and commands, including torrent-sourced media.

src/domains/motion.ts.name: Motion sensor mock
src/domains/motion.ts.description: Handles motion permission and subscriptions, pushing acceleration, rotation and orientation samples.

src/domains/serial.ts.name: Serial port mock
src/domains/serial.ts.description: Two seeded USB serial ports; open, write and close, with replies echoed back in uppercase by default.
